name: ReAct
purpose: ReAct addresses the limitations of traditional LLMs by combining chain-of-thought reasoning with external tool use. This allows LLMs to dynamically adjust their approach, gather real-time information, and overcome issues like hallucination and error propagation, leading to more accurate and reliable responses.
keyCapabilities: Effective utilization of external information and tools
integrations: Search engines (e.g., Wikipedia API, Google Search)
useCases: Interactive decision-making in environments (e.g., ALFWorld, WebShop)

researchPapers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
researchPapers.authors: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao
